policy: Deep Read findings are audit knowledge only. No PR/mail/schema-change disposition is implied.

findings.summary: System-Management example points to 5.1.2 although 5.1.3 is the document's System-Management section.
Part 1 example uses GetDeviceState/GetSystemStatus-style names; fresh Part 2 V1.0 and SystemManagement V1.0 XSD use GetDeviceStatus/GetServiceStatus terminology.
IBIS-IP appears twice consecutively in abbreviation table with slightly different expansion wording.
VDV cites RFC 2927 for 169.254/16 ZeroConf/link-local addressing; RFC 2927 is LDAP schema MIME profile, while RFC 3927 defines IPv4 link-local addressing.
VDV SRV Weight explanation implies lower weight preferred; RFC 2782 defines proportional selection with larger weights receiving higher probability.
PDF SystemConfigurationData.HertbeatIntervall is IBIS-IP.duration; exact V1.0 SystemDocumentation XSD declares it IBIS-IP.double, while StoreSystemConfigurationRequest uses duration.
findings.normative_validation_impact: XSD remains executable authority; SDK later should explain mismatch

findings.summary: GetDeviceStatusResponseData.DeviceState points to 9.3 DeviceClassEnumeration; DeviceStateEnumeration is 9.4.
SystemManagement operation table uses Subscribe/UnsubscribeServiceStatus but later headings use Subscribe/UnsubscribeSystemStatus.
findings.normative_validation_impact: do not synthesize SystemStatus operation aliases

findings.summary: SNTP section points to VDV 301-2-11; current public numbering assigns TimeService to 301-2-10. Historical numbering context must be checked before classification.
StopServiceRequest ServiceSpecification description says reference to service to be started although operation is StopService.
The German V2.0 ZeroConf text cites RFC 3927, the English text on the same bilingual passage still cites RFC 2927, while the bibliography lists RFC 3927.
findings.normative_validation_impact: runtime/documentation explanation only; do not make the English RFC 2927 wording normative

findings.summary: The V2.0 German and English SRV Weight explanations retain the lower-weight-preferred wording although RFC 2782 defines weighted proportional selection with larger weights receiving higher probability.

V2.0 history says the HeartbeatIntervall typo was corrected to HeartbeatInterval, and the official V2.0 XSD uses HeartbeatInterval, but the actual SystemDocumentation tables still print HertbeatIntervall.
findings.normative_validation_impact: exact V2.0 XSD name HeartbeatInterval remains executable authority; do not create typo alias

findings.summary: SystemDocumentation narrative contains SystemDocumenationService although the heading, operation table and official XSD use SystemDocumentationService.
SystemManagement main-task text contains an unresolved chapter-range reference ('Kapitel bis' / 'capitel bis').

The DMS operation inventory includes SubscribeDeviceInformation, but the detailed subsection sequence jumps from GetDeviceInformation to UnsubscribeDeviceInformation without a corresponding SubscribeDeviceInformation subsection heading.
findings.normative_validation_impact: none; operation support must not be inferred from PDF heading presence alone

findings.summary: The GetDeviceConfiguration description says the operation enables setting the device's variable parameter, although the following SetDeviceConfiguration operation is the setter and GetDeviceConfiguration is the retrieval operation.
findings.normative_validation_impact: none; do not invert operation semantics

findings.summary: The GetDeviceInformation response table describes the response structure/data as a request structure.

V2.1 system-configuration/system-start principles point DeviceManagementService to VDV 301-2-2 and SystemDocumentationService to VDV 301-2-4, although those identifiers belong to other service documents in the VDV 301-2 family.
findings.normative_validation_impact: none; resolver must not route schemas from these stale prose references

findings.summary: General Conventions V2.2 contains repeated literal unresolved Word cross-reference placeholders in device-class, system-start and XML/table-reference sections.
findings.normative_validation_impact: none; do not derive routing or validation rules from unresolved printed references

findings.summary: German V2.2 numbers both the SRV and TXT DNS-SD subsections as 3.3.1 and internally points TXT to 3.3.1; the English text correctly uses 3.3.1 for SRV and 3.3.2 for TXT.
Under section 7.2 Version 2.3, the German version-history subheadings are printed as 7.1.3 and 7.1.4 while the adjacent English subheadings correctly use 7.2.1 and 7.2.2.
